notes.title: Wheel of Innocence - Official Steam Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I'm happy to announce the official steam release for Wheel of Innocence is live right now! I'm excited for everyone to be able to play and if you experience any bugs feel free to create a discussion post about it.

Happy Gaming,
Merik (MKShadowZX)

notes.title: Wheel of Innocence - Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

The release date had to sadly be after the 22nd of this month and the earliest I'm able to put it at is the 24th of October at 12PM PDT. I'm very sorry for the confusion with the release date and time.

Kind Regards,
Merik (MKShadowZX)
